title: Book Two · Chapter 150: Before the First Day
story:
On the last quiet Sunday before school, Ronan lays his books on the table. He is thirteen and a half. Summer has made his arms brown, and the sleeves Mum opened now fit him exactly.

His practice folder lies beside a fresh notebook. He checks the pages in date order. There are good notes and notes about help. Some answers have changes after a teacher's question. He keeps those pages too.

Mum is packing her garden book into the little bag. Dad has the afternoon free. The blue bike stands clear of the green gate.

“Have you got everything?” Mum asks.

“Books. Folder. Pencils.”

“Lunch is tomorrow's problem.”

“Unless Dad eats it tonight.”

Dad looks at the bread. “A serious possibility.”

Ronan puts his hand over the packet. Mum laughs and moves it to the shelf.

After lunch, Leo comes to the door. He is back from the other town. He saw an ordinary school day there. He waited in a long lunch queue. One room had too many chairs.

“So it has normal problems,” Ronan says.

“Very normal.”

“Are you going?”

“Not this term. My family is still considering later.”

Leo puts a small folded page on the table. He has written a note about his next book. He shows Ronan, but he will take the note home. They look at it together for a few minutes.

Then Leo asks about the two places.

“I am going to try,” Ronan says.

“So am I.”

“Mei too.”

Leo nods. “She told me.”

They are quiet. Three friends want places. Only two pupils will become full members.

Dad comes to the doorway with the ball.

“Do you two still have feet?”

Ronan looks at Leo. Leo stands at once.

“At least four between us.”

They go to the square for a short game. Dad keeps the score badly on purpose until Mum catches him. Then she counts from her seat near the wall.

On the way back, Ronan sees the school gate at the end of the road. Tomorrow the room will open. The full rules will come. The practice will have new pages and questions. He does not know them yet.

Jun can still come to the ordinary reading activity. He may choose the other activity too. Mei will have her own pages. Leo will want the same place Ronan wants.

At home, Ronan puts the ball away and opens his bag. The folder slides in beside the fresh notebook. He checks that the corners are clear, then closes the flap.

Mum calls from the kitchen. She needs three cups.

Ronan brings them to the table. Dad pours the water. For the rest of the evening, the bag stays beside the chair.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

full member＝正式成员；queue＝队列；consider＝考虑；flap＝包盖。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan整理练习记录时保留了哪些内容？
2. 下一学期哪些事情已确定，哪些还没有？

## 读句子

**Ronan / brings them / to the table.** Ronan／把它们／拿到桌上。
